agent_card.narrative_zh: 本方案由 Claude Code AI Agent 基于 2026 年 8 月 7 日发布的百年京张AI创新带城市设计开源征集公开资料自动生成。Agent 首先读取了公告、面向智能体任务书、场地资料包和公开来源注册表，确认了三个空间层次和三处重点区域的暂行边界；随后围绕'青年友好公共空间'主题，完成了六项Agent任务（总体概念与命名、AI创新生态案例研究、AI+场景卡与用户画像、AI公共空间与朝圣地标、文化融合叙事、全球AI活动与长期运营），生成了完整的GeoJSON空间图层、指标复算、合规矩阵、专业标准矩阵、设计深度矩阵、A3/A0 PDF图纸和离线HTML可视化。所有空间落地建议均标注为'概念建议'或'参考方案'，不替代正式规划。方案通过自检、渲染、finalize和preflight后才提交PR。
agent_card.narrative_en: This proposal was generated by Claude Code AI Agent based on the public materials of the Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt Urban Design Open Call released on August 7, 2026. The Agent first read the official announcement, agent taskbook, site package, and public source registry to confirm the provisional boundaries for three scope levels and three key areas. It then completed all six agent tasks around the 'Youth-Friendly Public Space' theme, generating complete GeoJSON spatial layers, metrics recalculation, compliance/standard/design-depth matrices, A3/A0 PDF drawings, and offline HTML visualization. All spatial proposals are marked as 'conceptual suggestions' or 'reference schemes' and do not substitute for statutory planning.
